cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Count What I Did
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you call that a quick shop, I carried twelve bags up six flights. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I know. Sit down; I'll put everything away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Thank you. The frozen peas came up separately. That was a second trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you sit down twice. I'll make tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you tell everyone why I'm getting two rests? Otherwise it looks like one long sit.

mechanism: A directs shopping recovery while accepting B practical help only after turning it into visible recognition of A separate carrying trips.
confusable: Unlike simply wanting rest, A needs contribution acknowledged; unlike secure command A adapts the recovery arrangement to B proposed help.
comparison: A warm household rest-and-tea exchange differs from a fence repairer negotiating the wording of a neighbor recommendation.
seedUse: Use canonical D33-a two trips/two rests and S02-a claiming a helpful adjustment as the organizer plan.
